address.discrepancy_note: The business's own GlossGenius 'About' page and older Instagram captions/bio list an older address (7899 Pines Blvd, Pembroke Pines, FL 33024) and say 'Pembroke Pines, Florida'. Recent third-party aggregators (Fresha, Birdeye, GlowRoute) and the Birdeye review breakdown all independently agree on the Miami Gardens address, which also matches the phone number given in discovery. Interpreted as the business having relocated from Pembroke Pines (Broward) to Miami Gardens (Miami-Dade) without updating the IG bio/GlossGenius About page. Site was built with the Miami Gardens address as authoritative.

images_curation_note: Instagram feed yielded 29 downloadable real photos/video posters across 12 posts. Most were rejected by the visual quality gate: several selfies of the owner with text overlays, a screenshot of a map, unrelated shopping-trip/retail-store photos, a large product-haul carousel (13 flatlay images with text captions like 'Hair Mousse', 'New Clarifying Shampoo'), a meme-caption treatment photo, a before/after collage with 'DAY 1 / DAY 6' text overlay showing skin immediately post-treatment, and a close-up of an underarm area with visible post-wax redness. After discarding all of those, 6 real, non-text, non-selfie, non-irritated-skin images remained (5 gallery-quality + the business's own hero/cover shot), reused across hero/experience/gallery slots (same pattern the skeleton itself uses, e.g. reusing bk-6.jpg twice). This is at the site's minimum comfortable threshold; no stock or graphic imagery was used.
